changes.text:
@osr21 Both points land. Taking them in order.

On separating signature validity from identity binding — already true by design, not something I added for this: `verification_result_recomputed` in `verify.py` is the raw Ed25519 check, kept independent of any authority claim. The verifier prints this explicitly for `key_source='embedded'`:

> Recomputable: yes — public key ships inside this record, no external fetch.
> Anchored: NO — this key was chosen by whoever produced this checkpoint.
> Per verifier-key-source-ref-v1.md's own invariant 6 (recomputable_not_anchored): recomputability must ne
